fusions.name: Stinging Spindrift
fusions.desc: Blows spray and loose polyps through a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 7 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Reef Break
fusions.desc: A gust that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, throws it back 3 tiles onto raised reef and leaves it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Whistling Reef
fusions.desc: Grows a reef beside you for 15 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Settling Drift
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover lays down a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
